generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The intending bidder should have carried out supply, erection, testing and commissioning of anlayser instrument for water treatment plant or shall have carried out comprehensive annual maintenance of at least one similar work. As a proof, the bidder shall submit one job order or purchase order (invoice) or work done copy of value not less than Rs.7.50 Lakhs in any of the preceding five financial years (i.e., 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) issued by the officers of the rank Chief engineer or equivalent as a documentary proof.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- P.O/ Job Order/ Work done/ Performance certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should be OEM/OES or Supplier of anlayser instrument for water treatment plant or shall have carried out comprehensive annual maintenance (CAMC)/Annual maintenance (AMC) of similar works as a prime contractor. As a proof of this, relevant documents shall be uploaded in the bid document.

The bidder shall have minimum financial annual average turnover of Rs.15.00 Lakhs in at least two financial years during the last five financial years (i.e., 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload certified copy of the profit and loss account OR turn over certificate duly certified by Chartered Accountant.
